strategies.name: inside_bar_after_sma21_cross
strategies.description: After price clears completely above the 21 SMA from below, buy the break of the first bullish inside bar (first low-risk pullback of a new uptrend).

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Strategies
source.quote: These rules attempt to capture the first low-risk pullback in a new trend using an inside bar.

decisions: 'A price bar must clear above the SMA' = the bar's low crosses above SMA(21), at most 15 bars ago
'Bullish inside bar' = inside bar that closed above its open
The buy stop one tick above the inside bar is approximated by a close above the inside bar's high (the fill is later and worse than a real stop order)
Book does not define the stop; we use the inside bar's low (lowest_low(1), since lowest_low excludes the current bar)
Target 2R: the book's example made 2:1 when targeting the last extreme low
'Avoid congestion' is approximated with ADX(14) > 20
4-minute YM futures mapped to 5m-1h; risk 0.5% (the book gives no figure)
uncodable: Short side: price falls completely below the SMA, first bearish inside bar, sell stop below it
Discretionary congestion read (shadows on both ends of the bars)
Not coded yet: first_inside_bar_since(low crosses_above sma(21)) - only the FIRST inside bar after the cross should qualify
Not coded yet: stop_entry_above(high[1]) - intrabar stop-order fill
Not coded yet: target_at_last_swing_extreme

strategies.name: four_down_days_swing_low_holds
strategies.description: Fade 4+ consecutive down bars that fail to breach the last swing low; buy above the next bullish bar.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Strategies
source.quote: Using the market structure to filter consecutive up/down days is a simple method

decisions: 'Down day' = close below open (red_streak; check that the engine's red_streak uses close<open as the book does)
Setup bar = the first bullish bar (bar [1]) right after the streak, which ends at bar [2]
'Has not breached the last swing low' is approximated as: the lowest low of the streak and setup bars (bars 1-5) stays above the lowest low of the 20 bars before them
The buy stop one tick above the setup bar is approximated by a close above its high
Stop and target are not given by the book; stop below the low of the streak and setup (6 bars), target 2R
Daily stock examples (ROST, SPY) mapped to 4h/1d
uncodable: Short side: 4+ up days not breaching the last swing high, sell below the next bearish bar
Deceleration / Anti-climax thrust patterns (only named, defined in the author's course)
Not coded yet: swing_low_pivot (last confirmed swing low)
Not coded yet: stop_entry_above(high[1])
Not coded yet: red_streak with variable length ending at the bar before the setup bar (the streak may be longer than 4 and the first bullish bar may come later)

strategies.name: enhanced_three_bar_reversal
strategies.description: Alton Hill's three-bar reversal: down bar, lower-low middle bar, then a bar that closes above the highs of both prior bars; buy at the close.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Strategies
source.quote: Bar 3 closes above the high of both Bar 1 and Bar 2

decisions: Entry at the close of bar 3, as in the book

The book puts the stop at the opposite end of the signal bar (bar 3's low). The grammar's lowest_low excludes the current bar, so we use the pattern low (bar 2's low, lowest_low(2)). That stop is wider; size is kept constant by risk_pct
The book's warning about an outside middle bar becomes a filter: bar 2's high must not exceed bar 1's high
Target not given; 2R
5-minute ES/YM futures mapped to 5m/15m
lowest_low(2) is the low of bar 2, which by the entry rules is the lowest of the three bars
uncodable: Short side: bar 1 up, bar 2 higher high, bar 3 closes below the lows of bars 1 and 2
Discretionary context (head and shoulders confluence, long tails = congestion warning)

strategies.name: nr7_ema20_trend_breakout
strategies.description: In an uptrend where the last 7 bars are completely above the 20 EMA, buy the break of an NR7 bar's high.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Strategies
source.quote: NR7 means narrow bar 7. It is a bar that has a smaller range than the six bars before it.

decisions: 'Past 7 bars completely above the 20 EMA' = the lows of the NR7 bar and the 6 bars before it are above the EMA(20) of each bar
Break of the NR7 high is approximated by a close above it (no intrabar stop orders)
Stop at the NR7 bar's opposite extreme (its low), as in the book's example
Book warning: skip NR7 at the trend high and wait for a real pullback. Coded as: the NR7 high is below the prior 10-bar high
Book warning: multiple NR7s mean congestion. Coded as: the previous bar is not also an NR7
3-minute CL futures mapped to 5m-1h; target 2R (not given)
uncodable: Short side: 7 bars completely below the 20 EMA, sell on a break of the NR7 low
Re-entry after a whipsaw while the trend holds
'Path of least resistance' judgement

strategies.name: trend_bar_failure_long
strategies.description: In an uptrend (20 EMA sloping up), a bear trend bar's low is broken without follow-through; buy above the high of the breaking bar within one bar.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Strategies
source.quote: If a trend bar is not followed by another trend bar

decisions: '20 EMA sloping up' = EMA(20) one bar ago is above its value two bars earlier
Bear trend bar (body > 50% of range) is APPROXIMATED as a red bar that is not a doji. The grammar has no body/range feature, see needs

'Low of bear trend bar broken' = the next bar (bar [1]) makes a lower low; buy stop above that bar's high, valid for 1 bar. Coded as a close above high[1] on the very next bar, which keeps the book's one-bar expiry
Stop below the low of the breaking bar (not specified by the book); target 2R
Book shows 5-minute to monthly charts; mapped to 5m, 1h, 1d
Bear trend bar = down bar whose body is at least 50% of its range (body_pct[2] >= 0.5)
uncodable: Short side: EMA sloping down, bull trend bar whose high is broken, sell stop below the low within one bar
'or if your trend assessment is bullish' discretionary alternative
Not coded yet: stop_entry_above(high[1]) with 1-bar expiry
Not coded yet: bar [1] must not itself be a bear trend bar (not expressible as one AND condition)

strategies.name: m2b_two_legged_pullback_ema20
strategies.description: Al Brooks M2B: in a strong uptrend, a two-legged pullback to the 20 EMA; buy above the bar that tested the EMA.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Strategies
source.quote: he identified a two-legged pullback to the moving average as one of the best trade

decisions: 'Strong uptrend' = ADX(14) > 25, +DI > -DI and EMA(20) rising over 10 bars
'Bar that tested the 20 EMA' = bar [1] whose low touched or pierced EMA(20) but closed above it (rejection)
Pullback present = bar [1]'s high is below the prior 10-bar high. The TWO-legged count cannot be expressed, see needs
The buy stop one tick above the test bar is approximated by a close above its high
Stop below the test bar's low (not given in the book); target 2R
needs: two_legged_pullback (leg counting: a bar with a higher high starts an up-leg, a lower low starts a down-leg; require 2 down-legs since the swing high)
uncodable: Short side (M2S): two-legged pullback up to the 20 EMA in a strong downtrend
Discretionary 'clear EMA rejection' and 'space between price and MA' momentum read
Not coded yet: the two-legged pullback needs leg counting; the approximation would be a different strategy

strategies.name: high_close_doji_pivot_support
strategies.description: John Person style: a doji at a support level followed by a bar closing above the doji's high; buy at that close.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Strategies
source.quote: Basically, wait for a doji. Then, look out for a candlestick to close

decisions: Doji = grammar doji (body <= 10% of range); the book does not quantify it
Floor-pivot supports (S1/S2 from the prior session) are unavailable. APPROXIMATED as: the doji's low is within 0.3% of the prior 50-bar low (a local support level)
Buy at the close of the bar that closes above the doji's high (the high-close doji), as in the book
Stop below the doji and the bar before it (not given); target 2R in place of the next pivot level (S1 after an S2 entry)
5-minute ES futures mapped to 5m/15m
needs: floor_pivots(prior session/day): pp, s1, s2, r1, r2 with PP=(H+L+C)/3, S1=2PP-H, S2=PP-(H-L)
count of dojis near the level (multiple dojis = better)
uncodable: Short side: doji at resistance, sell on close of a low close doji
Quality filters: no strong bearish bars, a preceding failed low-close doji
Not coded yet: needs floor pivot levels (PP, S1, S2) from the prior session

strategies.name: bullish_engulfing_market_structure
strategies.description: In an uptrend of higher swing highs and lows, buy a bullish engulfing pattern whose high is still below the previous swing high.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Strategies
source.quote: uses the concept of market structure to find point us in the right direction.

decisions: 'Higher swing high and higher swing low' = trend_structure == +1
Previous swing high approximated as the highest high of the 20 bars before the pattern; both pattern bars' highs must stay below it (book rule 3)
Enter at the engulfing bar's close with no confirmation bar, as the book says
Stop below the low of the 2 bars before the engulfing bar (this does not cover the engulfing bar's own low; see needs); target 2R in place of the previous swing high
Daily stock examples (AGN, CAH) mapped to 4h/1d
Stop just below the engulfing bar's own low (0.999*low), which is the pattern low
uncodable: Short side: lower swing highs and lows, bearish engulfing whose low stays above the previous swing low
Discretion to avoid sideways ranges where swings do not break out
Not coded yet: swing_high_pivot (previous confirmed swing high) and target_at_previous_swing_high

strategies.name: hikkake_long
strategies.description: Dan Chesler's Hikkake: an inside bar followed by a false breakdown bar (lower high and lower low); buy when price takes out the inside bar's high.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Strategies

decisions: The book's buy order at the inside bar's high, valid for the next 3 bars, is coded ONLY for the first bar after the false breakdown bar (close above the inside bar's high); fills on bars 2-3 are missed
Stop below the false-breakdown low (lowest_low(2) = low of bar [1]); the book gives no stop; target 2R
Daily LSE stock examples mapped to 4h/1d
uncodable: Short side: inside bar followed by a higher high and higher low, sell at the inside bar's low within 3 bars
Trapped-trader context judgement

Not coded yet: outside_bar (setup often fails when triggered by an outside bar)

strategies.name: low_volume_pullback_long
strategies.description: Above the 20 SMA, after a breakout over the last swing high on higher volume, a pullback on lower volume; buy above the next bullish bar.

source.book: How to Trade with Price Action: Strategies
source.quote: the idea is to fade low volume moves.

decisions: 'Last swing high' approximated as the 20-bar highest high; breakout within the last 10 bars
'Higher volume' on the breakout approximated as rel_volume(20) > 1.2 within 10 bars (it cannot be tied to the exact breakout bar)
'Price falls with lower volume' = bar [2] is a down bar with less volume than the bar before it (the book compares volume with the previous bar)
'Next bullish bar' = bar [1] closes above its open; the buy stop above it is approximated by a close above its high
Stop below the pullback low (3 bars); target 2R (the book only says the potential exceeded the risk)
Weekly ETF and daily stock examples mapped to 4h/1d
uncodable: Short side: below the 20 SMA, break of the last swing low on higher volume, rise on lower volume, sell below the next bearish bar
Check for larger overhead resistance (losing Walmart example)

Not coded yet: condition pairing (breakout bar AND higher volume on the same bar within N bars)
